SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the C1-1,
Neighborhood Commercial District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 26-G
and Map No. 28-G in the area bound by:

West 110! Place; the east right-of-way line of the Pennsylvania Railroad; a line 125 feet
south of and parallel to West 110'" Place; a line 125 feet west of and parallel to South
Morgan Street; a line 200 feet south of and parallel to West 110' Place; a line 135 feet
west of and parallel to South Morgan Street; West 111" Street; the west right-of-way line
of the Pennsylvania Railroad; the alley next south of and parallel to West 111* Street; a
line 49.15 feet west of and parallel to South Aberdeen Street; West 111" Street; and

South Aberdeen Street,
to those of a B3-2, Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.
